segments.name: Industrial equipment
segments.description: Manufactures and sells oilfield-specialized vehicles and equipment, and is developing modular gas-to-electricity power systems for AI data centers.
segments.evidence: Our main products currently include oil pumping trucks, oil-well repair trucks, fracking trucks, well flushing-wax removal trucks, boiler trucks, and other maintenance vehicles.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for oilfield-specialized vehicles, equipment components, vehicle integration and automation solutions.
revenueModel.evidence: Our existing business primarily comprises the research and development, manufacturing and sale of oilfield-specialized production and maintenance equipment, as well as the sale of related equipment components, integration of specialized oilfield vehicles and provision of automation solutions.
